## About
Reliable Auto Service Center is a state certified auto repair facility serving the greater Allen Park area. Whether you need a simple tune-up, hear a clunk from your rear end or squealing from your brakes, our technicians handle it bumper to bumper, big jobs or small.
Customers tell us they like being able to trust their mechanics. One reviewer said the owner and staff are always polite and answer her questions. Another said we knew right away what the problem was and fixed it quickly.
We're rated 4.8 from 337 Google reviews, and we look forward to making you a customer for life.

## Services
- Computer diagnostics and repair: When your check engine light comes on, the error codes tell us which system is having an issue and where to start our diagnostic process.
- Brakes and suspension service: Squealing brakes, worn struts or ball joints. We handle complete brake system repairs and ABS diagnostics too.
- Tune-ups: A simple tune-up for your car or truck, done right.
- Exhaust repair and installation: From a single repair to complete exhaust systems.
- Transmission service: Drive train service, transmission diagnostics and overhaul.
- Engine & Cooling System Service, Water Pumps, Timing Belts: Engine and cooling work, including water pumps and timing belts.
- Diesel Diagnostics and Service: We work on diesels as well as gas cars and trucks.
- No Start Troubleshooting & Repair: Car won't start? We'll track down why and fix it.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Cars, trucks, vans, diesels, domestics, foreign and everything in between. We also do fleet services and large commercial vehicle repairs, so just ask.

Q: What does my check engine light mean?
A: The computer stores error codes that tell us which system is having an issue and where to start. They usually don't point to the exact faulty part, so that's where our diagnostic process begins.

Q: Do you have any specials?
A: Yes, there's a web special coupon on our website. Show it at drop off. It can't be combined with any other offer, and there may be other restrictions, so call for details.

Q: Can you help with towing?
A: Ask us about discounted towing when you call.
